intro.text: A darkeyed youth from a farming family in Hearthstone.

items.text: Naget often pulled diggerworms from the lavis fields near town. He was among the youths who watched Kaladin pick up a weapon for the first time, to fight Jost.
A few years on, no longer friendly with Kaladin, Naget was there when Amaram came to Hearthstone to recruit. He did not volunteer and avoided being conscripted.

appearance.text: Naget is darkeyed with light hair, spindly and the tallest of the town's youths.

personality.text: Naget is curious about whether a darkeyes can really become lighteyed by winning a Shardblade.
